chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
I guarantee Paradise with Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, for whoever visits the grave of my father in Tus, recognizing his right.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the Imam’s father
key_terms.بِطُوسَ: in Tus, the location of the grave
key_terms.زَارَ: visited in the sense of performing ziyārah
key_terms.عَارِفًا بِحَقِّهِ: recognizing his right, rank, and due authority
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Exalted, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.قَبْرَ: the grave or burial place being visited

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام in Tus while recognizing his right?
ai.summary: Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Jawād عليه السلام states the immense reward for visiting the grave of his father in Tus with proper recognition of his right. The hadith links ziyārah with maʿrifah, promising Jannah by Allah’s leave for the one whose visitation is grounded in true acknowledgment.
